title: SAGE Labs
description: SAGE Labs gives Star Atlas a browser-native economy and industrial loop that makes ownership and logistics feel real.
heroTitle: SAGE Labs is where the economy becomes tangible.
heroSummary: This page frames SAGE Labs as the industrial and logistical backbone of the browser ecosystem, helping visitors understand how market activity connects to production and movement.
utilityLine: The redesign keeps the explanation practical and calm so the system feels trustworthy instead of opaque.

heroMedia.label: Economy preview
heroMedia.caption: Industrial systems are now framed as part of a coherent product story.

heroPanel.title: This is where the economy stops being abstract.
heroPanel.body: SAGE Labs turns assets and market intent into active systems. That makes the broader Star Atlas pitch feel more concrete and more premium.
bullets: A stronger reason to care about assets

sections.heading: How SAGE Labs strengthens the ecosystem story.

cards.title: Production has a visible role
cards.body: The browser economy is easier to trust when it clearly connects to manufacturing and supply.

cards.title: Logistics creates consequence
cards.body: Transport, scanning, and deployment make the system feel operational rather than theoretical.

cards.title: Assets become active tools
cards.body: Value feels more meaningful when assets participate in loops instead of sitting as static inventory.

sections.heading: A premium economy page should create confidence, not friction.
body: The old site mixed too much utility and jargon too early. This version reframes SAGE Labs with a clearer narrative: what it does, why it matters, and where it fits in the broader system.
That makes the economy more approachable without flattening its depth.
sections.asideTitle: Visitors understand why the economy matters faster.
sections.asideBody: The page uses less operational clutter and more deliberate explanation.

finalCta.title: Move from browser systems into the full economy picture.
finalCta.text: See the marketplace, read the economy page, or return to the game overview with a stronger mental model.
